source: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2: capacity reduction factors φ for Class N reinforcement

sources.tension: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2: bending without axial tension, Class N bars, φ = 1.24 - 13 kuo/12 within 0.65-0.85 (phiTransition: 0.85 up to kuo 0.36, 0.65 from kuo 0.545)
sources.compressionTied: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2: members in compression, φ = 0.65 (no spiral distinction)
sources.shear: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2: shear and torsion φ = 0.75 (Class N, the 2018 value; 0.7 in the 2009 edition)
sources.punching: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2 / 9.3: φ = 0.75 (uncertain: to be checked)
sources.shearSeismic: AS 3600 has no reduced φ for seismic shear: 0.75 (SAEngine practice)
sources.strutAndTie: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2: struts φst = 0.6 (ties 0.8): 0.6 for the whole model (SAEngine practice, safe side)
sources.stiffnessReduction: AS 3600:2018 10.4.4: the buckling load Nc with φ = 0.6 (the nearest of the moment magnifier's factor)
sources.plain: AS 3600:2018 Table 2.2.2 / Section 20: unreinforced concrete φ = 0.6
sources.axialCap: AS 3600 has no axial cap; it asks for a minimum eccentricity 0.05 D (10.1.2): SAEngine keeps the parent's 0.80 φ P0 cap in its place (SAEngine practice)
